_notes: This is a TEMPLATE. Copy the SAP Commerce starter over it: `cp working-docs/profiles/sap-commerce.json working-docs/config.json`, then adjust <ext> and versions.
Every VERB a stage checkpoint references must exist in 'build'. A verb may be 'MANUAL: <steps>' — stages print the steps and wait instead of running a command.
buildTool: 'gradle' (./gradlew) or 'ant' (setantenv.sh + ant) — the sap-commerce profile documents the exact verb swap for ant.
Set jira.mode to 'mcp' if the Atlassian MCP connector is available in your Claude Code session; 'manual' if Jira exists but is unreachable; 'none' if there is no Jira.
The repo's CLAUDE.md is authoritative for conventions; restate the load-bearing ones (never edit gensrc/platform/OOTB, alias pattern, yclean-before-ybuild, stop-server-before-tests) here.
